description: If \(\Gamma\vert\tau\) is empty, every extension of \(\tau\) satisfies \(\Gamma\); if it contains an empty clause, no extension satisfies \(\Gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.residual_terminal.{u} {α : Type u}
  (τ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.PartialAssignment α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.residual τ Γ = [] →
      ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Extends v τ →
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models v Γ) ∧
    ([] ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.residual τ Γ →
      ¬∃ v,
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Extends v τ ∧
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models v Γ)
